Arizona Renaissance Festival

Plan chauffeured transportation to the Arizona Renaissance Festival around its current calendar, entry and parking rules, pickup location, and scheduled return.

Highlights

  • Current festival calendar and gate hours
  • Published performers and entertainment
  • Food and beverage options
  • Current parking and entry rules
  • Costume and prop policies checked directly
  • Artisan marketplace if operating

A typical day

  1. Late morning pickup
  2. Drive to the current festival access point
  3. Festival visit within the confirmed service window
  4. Ticketed entertainment selected by the group
  5. Artisan marketplace if operating
  6. Dining purchased directly at the festival
  7. Return to Scottsdale

Frequently asked questions

When is the Renaissance Festival?

The festival's official visitor FAQ controls the current calendar, directions, ticket, bag, parking, re-entry, and accessibility policies. Review those details and purchase admission directly before submitting transportation times.

Should we wear costumes?

Costumes are optional, but guests should check the festival's current costume, prop, and entry policies directly before the event.

Is alcohol available?

Food and alcohol availability is controlled by the festival and current law. Check the current vendor and admission policies directly; purchases are not included in transportation.
